title: Aon and funds managed by Blackstone launch Cortina, a new Lloyd's syndicate offering efficient, long-term capital to reinsurance clients
summary: - Participating Aon clients benefit from the efficient structure through a client dividend - Operating within Lloyd’s, with QBE as Managing Agent, Cortina is expected to begin underwriting from 1 January 2027
